_comment: Arm settings for motion.py. Lift in mm of carriage travel, base in degrees of yaw (CAD: 0 = boom along +X, positive = counterclockwise from above). gear_ratio = motor degrees per unit. Taught pockets and measured travel live in config/taught.json on the Pi (TEACH / CALIBRATE).
_joints: lift: rack and pinion, 20T m1.2 pinion = 75.40 mm per motor turn (360/75.40 = 4.7746). It backdrives when the motor lets go, so its stall protection stays OFF (a trip releases the shaft). base: motor drives the turntable 1:1 through the B06 adapter; the 0.3 mm tab play is taken up by always finishing a move turning the 'approach' way. dir_bit_positive: CHECK on the arm (jog lift +5 must go UP, jog base +5 must turn counterclockwise from above).
_homing: hard_stop = drive slowly into the stop until the motor lags (Surya's seek), then that spot is stop_at. marked_zero = the arm is parked at marked_at when motion starts. The lift has no clear spot to go all the way down (the jaws always meet a platform), so it seeks UP to its solid top stop, nominally 70 mm (CAD stroke). The 3D-printed lift guide is tight 40-48 mm above pick height: the climbing lag reaches its 18 deg ceiling there, but the shaft keeps moving. It can also stick there for a moment and break free. So 'blocked' (both the seek and the obstruction check) means lag over the limit AND the shaft nearly stopped (under stuck_fraction of its commanded speed over stuck_window_s), for block_s; inside the lift's tight_band, for tight_band_block_s (the seek uses seek_stuck_s). Both drivers' lag reading (0x39) saturates at 18.0 deg, so every limit must stay below that. The base seeks its clockwise stop, which sits at -88.3 deg in the CAD frame (dock A centred at -51.0 when the stop was called -79.3); measured stop-to-stop range 158.6 deg. calibrate_both_ends re-measures the base range (CALIBRATE).
_poses: Pockets default to the CAD docks (145 mm radius): A -60, B -20, OUT +20, C +60 deg; lift heights are placeholders until taught. Vision box N = pocket N; TEACH overrides these in taught.json. travel_lift must clear the dock platforms while the base turns (motion refuses to turn the base below it). home_pose parks the arm at the model's built-in home, the clockwise end (CAD park index -82 deg), out of the camera's view of the docks.
